description:
In the past 30 years, Toyota has made six generations of the RAV4, but this 1st generation 1998 Toyota RAV4 L is the most iconic compact SUV ever produced. It is reliable, sturdy, practical, fun to drive and the styling really sets it apart from the competition.

My Mom purchased this RAV4 L new from South Coast Toyota. It was given to me as my first car, so even though I am the second owner, the RAV4 L has been with just one family all these years.

The RAV4 L has a 127 hp 16-valve engine with a 4-speed ECT overdrive automatic transmission and front wheel drive. It has 4 passenger doors plus a side-opening rear door, air conditioning that works great, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, cruise control, Toyota AM/FM/CD/cassette with four speakers, factory tinted windows, factory security system, tilt steering wheel, rear window defroster and wiper, ABS brakes, a keyless entry system, driver and passenger air bags, a locking glove box and a factory optioned roof rack. The RAV4 L has fulling reclining front bucket seats, a split rear bench seat that folds or flips forward for extra cargo space, and a rear cargo area that is huge. The fabric seats are in really good condition considering the age of this vehicle.

This RAV4L has always been well cared for with oil changes every 5,000 miles. It has Pirelli Scorpion tires that were mounted in 2022. In recent years, we have replaced the timing belt, installed a new radiator, replaced the oil pump seals and replaced the motor mounts. The car runs great! The air conditioning blows cold!

The paint on the hood of the car is showing its age, with several chips, but this is a reliable, mechanically sound, low-maintenance car that is easy to drive, easy to park, easy to get in and out of and it even gets good gas mileage. It's a TOYOTA! You really have to see it to appreciate it. It's located in the city of Orange, California, if you want to take it for a test drive.

description:
2004 Mercury Mountaineer- Sport Utility 4D for sale in Ahwatukee. ~163,000 miles with original 4.6L SOHC V8 Engine and Automatic Transmission w/ AWD, clean title.

Overall in good condition for a 20+ year old car. Only cosmetic damage is some paint chipping, with a patch of surface rust across the roof of the vehicle, visible in pictures. No warning lights and drives quite smooth for such a large and heavy, yet safe vehicle.

This SUV has only been in my family since it was new, passed down through four generations. All maintenance has been done only by the original dealership, my father, or myself. It has been a daily driver for the last 20 years, and was my first vehicle. However, as I now have other modes of transportation, I no longer have a need for the vehicle aside from its extremely limited use.

This SUV features a few upgrades over its original including a Pioneer AVH-2400 sound system with a backup camera, apple carplay and android auto, bluetooth compatibility, and more. Has premium leather seating.

The entire suspension system was rebuilt in 2020, a new cooling system installed in September of 2025 with new 2025 tires installed shortly afterward, and all spark plugs and coil boots replaced just in January of 2026. Less than 1000 miles since the last oil change. The concern of a cracking intake manifold on this model, which would result in coolant leaks, has been solved with an aftermarket replacement that is much more durable. Powered drivers seat recently came dislodged from track, not yet fixed.

This model also features folding second and third row seats, making for a large rear of the vehicle with lots of storage space! The large build, and therefore safety of the car, could make a great everyday family car or even a good first car for another new driver.

Lots of time, energy, and money has been put into this car to keep it up and running. Asking $5000 obo.

description:
My family has owned this Jeep for the past three years and it's been a reliable workhorse and great in the Central Oregon Winters.

It's been a labor of love and recent repairs include:
New Alternator
New Battery
New Thermostat
New Water pump
New Crankshaft position sensor
New EVAP Purge Solenoid
I have also installed a fuel pump relay bypass (helps improve starting reliability under certain conditions).

The Tires are Pinza A/T From Les Schwab (Three Peaks Rated for Winter) and have a lot of tread left.

The interior has a sunroom and leather heated seats.

Overall it's in good condition with a few scratches and a few small tears, but nothing out of the ordinary for a 2008 vehicle.

It runs and drives great.

Selling this cheap because It does have one issue that I have bee working through. From time to time, after the engine is hot and I've made multiple short errand stops, like driving to Bend from Sunriver and making 4 or 5 stops, there are a few times when the car will crank but will not start. It eventually always will start, but it may take a few tries, or it may take waiting a few minutes again and that can be frustrating.

I believe this is pretty common with these Jeeps. I've gone down a deep diagnostic hole and the condition has gotten much better, but it has still occurred a handful of times. I believe it's related to the under hood TIPM, but I have not been able to get a specific diagnosis as it's so intermittent. I want to be transparent for any potential buyer. Cold starts are no problem, it runs and drives great, but this may be perfect for someone familiar with the Jeep specific quirks.

Contact me with any questions.
Cheers!
